title: 第80章 青砖

第80章 青砖-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》

挖到第五十一天的时候，王建新所在的西段率先挖到了硬层。

那天下午，太阳偏西，工地上的光线开始发暗。王建新站在坑底，铁锹铲下去，碰到的不再是松软的泥土，而是坚硬的砖石。他蹲下来，用手扒开浮土，露出一层青灰色的老砖。砖的尺寸比现在的砖大，厚实，密密地砌在一起，缝隙里填着白色的石灰，硬得跟石头一样。

“停。”王建新直起身，喊了一声。

三班的人停下来，围过来看。刘晓东蹲下来，用手摸了摸那些青砖，又敲了敲，声音发闷，但有一块砖敲上去声音不一样，空空的，像敲鼓。

“队长，这砖后面好像是空的。”刘晓东说。

王建新也蹲下来，用铁锹的柄轻轻敲了几下。确实，有几块砖的声音明显不同。他用神识仔细扫了一下——青砖后面是一个密闭的空间，不大，但里面的东西密密麻麻地码着。金条、金元宝、银锭、玉器，一层一层，整整齐齐。

他没有声张，站起来，对身边的人说：“都别动了。这可能是老建筑的基础，别破坏了。你们先上去，我去找韩干部。”

他爬出坑，拍了拍身上的土，快步走向工地的临时办公室。韩干部正坐在桌前喝茶，看见王建新进来，放下茶缸。

“怎么了？”

“韩干部，我们挖到一层老青砖，位置很深，不像是普通的基础。砖后面有空腔，可能有东西。我建议先停工，请文物部门来看看。”

韩干部愣了一下，放下茶缸，跟着王建新来到工地。他蹲在坑边，看了看那些青砖，又敲了敲，听了听声音。他虽然不懂考古，但干了这么多年行政，这点判断力还是有的。这砖的形制、砌法，不像是民国以后的，至少是清中期的。

“停工。”韩干部站起来，拍了拍手上的土，“所有人撤出工地，原地待命。谁也不许再动那块地方。我去打电话。”

消息报上去，层层上报，不到两个小时，学校革委会、街道、公安、文物部门的人都来了。先是学校革委会的主任、接着是街道革委会的干部，派出所的民警，最后来的是文物局的两个专家，一个五十多岁，头发花白，戴着厚底眼镜；一个三十出头，瘦高个，背着一个帆布工具包。他们下到坑里，蹲在那些青砖前面，看了好一会儿。

老专家用手指摸了摸砖缝里的石灰，又拿起一块碎砖在手里掂了掂，翻来覆去地看。他跟年轻专家低声说了几句什么，年轻专家点点头，从包里拿出相机，“咔嚓咔嚓”拍了几张照片。

On the 51st day of digging, the western section where Wang Jianxin was located took the lead in digging the hard layer.

That afternoon, the sun was setting in the west, and the light on the construction site began to dim.Wang Jianxin stood at the bottom of the pit and shoveled down. What he encountered was no longer soft soil, but hard masonry.He squatted down and used his hands to remove the floating soil, revealing a layer of blue-grey old bricks.The bricks were larger than today's bricks, thicker, and densely laid together. The gaps were filled with white lime, which was as hard as stone.

"Stop." Wang Jianxin straightened up and shouted.

People from class three stopped and gathered around to watch.Liu Xiaodong squatted down, touched the green bricks with his hands, and knocked again. The sound was muffled, but when one brick was knocked up, the sound was different. It was hollow, like beating a drum.

"Captain, there seems to be nothing behind this brick." Liu Xiaodong said.

Wang Jianxin also squatted down and tapped lightly with the handle of the shovel.Indeed, there are several bricks that sound noticeably different.He scanned it carefully with his spiritual consciousness - there was a closed space behind the blue bricks. It was not big, but the things inside were densely packed.Gold bars, gold ingots, silver ingots, and jades are arranged neatly layer by layer.

He stood up without saying anything and said to the people around him: "Don't move. This may be the foundation of the old building. Don't destroy it. You go up first, and I'll go find Cadre Han."

He climbed out of the pit, patted the dirt on his body, and walked quickly to the temporary office at the construction site.Cadre Han was sitting at the table drinking tea when he saw Wang Jianxin come in and put down the teapot.

"What's wrong?"

"Cadre Han, we dug out a layer of old blue bricks. The location is very deep. It doesn't look like an ordinary foundation. There is a cavity behind the bricks, and there may be something there. I suggest we stop the work first and ask the cultural relics department to take a look."

Cadre Han was stunned for a moment, put down the tea vat, and followed Wang Jianxin to the construction site.He squatted by the pit, looked at the blue bricks, knocked them again, and listened to the sound.Although he doesn't understand archeology, he still has some judgment after working in administration for so many years.The shape and construction method of this brick do not look like they were made after the Republic of China, at least in the mid-Qing Dynasty.

"Stop work." Cadre Han stood up and patted the dirt on his hands. "Everyone evacuated the construction site and stood by. No one is allowed to touch that area anymore. I'll make a call."

The news was reported to the public, and within two hours, people from the school's revolutionary committee, street, public security, and cultural relics departments were all here.First came the director of the school revolutionary committee, then the cadres of the street revolutionary committee, the police from the police station, and finally two experts from the Cultural Relics Bureau. One was in his fifties, with gray hair, wearing thick-soled glasses; the other was in his early thirties, tall and thin, carrying a canvas tool bag.They went down to the pit and squatted in front of the blue bricks, looking at them for a long time.

The old expert touched the lime in the cracks of the bricks with his fingers, then picked up a broken brick and weighed it in his hand, turning it over and over.He whispered something to the young expert. The young expert nodded, took out his camera from his bag, and took a few photos.
